rules.rule: 1. SOURCE     every note says where it came from
2. CONNECTED  no note is left floating on its own
3. STRINGS    strings join sensible kinds of note
4. COMPLETE   every fault has a cause and a fix
5. AGREEMENT  no two notes contradict each other
problems: settled: "The report states that the arc voltage was 17.8 V,..." is disputed, overruled by arc_voltage_spec

rules.rule: 6. BELONGING  every note belongs to a machine that exists
